newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Volatility stays high in Cascade.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Volatility stays high in Cascade.

text.p: As shares of Cascade Communications Corp lost about 35 percent of their value, investors in the options were placing bets on both sides -- that the stock would continue to fall or recover.
But traders said investors were in agreement that the sharp moves are not over.

"Volatilities are pretty high," a trader at the Chicago Board Options Exchange said. "Usually after you get a big move, volatility starts to come in because people thing that was the big move. But the volatility is staying high."
"I think people are anticipating this is going to keep moving," the trader said, referring to Cascade stock.
Traders said volatilities in the February series were around 80 and slipped to around 75 in the March series and 70 in the April options.
By about 1400 CST/2000 GMT, shares of the data networking company were down 22-3/8, or about 35 percent, at 41-3/4, off their session low of 40.
More than 38 million shares changed hands.
The company on Thursday reported fourth quarter earnings that beat analysts' expectations, but company comments in a later conference call raised fears about future earnings.
Several analysts slashed investment ratings on Cascade.
But options investors were not all turning bearish.
"We've got mainly buyers of puts and calls," the trader in Chicago said. "People are anticipating the stock to go further downard or maybe make a move back up."
He said most of the orders were from retail clients, with activity seen in nearly every strike in every month.
Cascade options trade on four of the five options exchanges, with most trading on the CBOE.
The busiest option was the February 45 call, with consolidated turnover of about 6,135 contracts.
Other active options included the February 55 call, the February 45 put and the March 45 call.
Traders said the selloff in Cascade spilled over into a couple other stocks including Ascend Communications Inc and Newbridge Networks Corp, both of which have options.
Ascend shares were unchanged at 75-3/4 in late trade after falling to 71 intraday. Volume was heavy at about 5.5 million shares.
Shares of Newbridge Networks traded in the U.S. lost 1-5/8 to 32-1/2.
Options on those two stocks were not heavily traded but the Ascend March 70 call made the most actives list at the American Stock Exchange, with volume of about 2,135 contracts.
The option was down 2-1/8 at 8-1/4 and through Thursday had open interest of a little more than 1,400 contracts. ((--G.Crawford, 312 408 8750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
